site_lines_25_60: 26|  *  1. Opening it sends one GET. It does not create a traveller, a journey, or a demo scenario. The
27|  *     shell's own boot read is `GET /journeys/<stored id>/experience`, which writes while it answers
28|  *     and is the reason this project has a 500 for opening a page; the person arriving here is not the
29|  *     traveller whose journey that is, and `app/V8Experience.tsx`'s boot now says so before it asks.
30|  *  2. Every refusal is named by the server's `error.reason_code`, never by something this device
31|  *     worked out. `sharedJourneyDoors.ts` holds the whole vocabulary and a body that carries no name
32|  *     lands in `unnamed`, which says "no name was read" rather than picking the nearest sentence.
33|  *  3. There is no arm that reads "loaded, and here is your empty rectangle". The two ways a
34|  *     successful read can still have nothing to list are different facts -- no plan was ever selected,
35|  *     and a plan is selected with no stops in it -- and each gets its own sentence below.
36|  *  4. Nothing on this screen is a raw store value pretending to be a heading. A stop is the place's
37|  *     own name, falling back to the plan's title only when the store has no name; the plan's `source`
38|  *     and `status` go through the shared display tables; and the only instants shown are formatted in
39|  *     the trip's own timezone. The token itself is never painted -- it is the thing that grants access,
40|  *     and a screenshot of this page should not hand the trip to whoever receives the screenshot.
